warnings.desc: Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce damaging winds and heavy rainfall that may lead to flash flooding in the warning area over the next several hours. Locations which may be affected include Laverton, Leinster, Leonora, Menzies and Wiluna. A 90km/h wind gust was recorded at Wiluna Airport at 2:17pm.
